# FSR-Vulkan

FSR 3.1 upscaling and frame generation and the FSR 4 v07 provider over native Vulkan, from
FireBurn's FSR-Vulkan (https://github.com/FireBurn/FSR-Vulkan, MIT, see `LICENSE.txt` and
`NOTICE.md`) at commit `c64f093`. The first commit here is the files the build reads as they were
there; later ones change them.

Left out: `tests/`, `examples/`, `tools/` (shader and SPIR-V generators), `.github/`, the
`VP_VULKANINFO_*.json` device profile, `README.md`, `PUBLISHING.md` and `.gitignore`.
